Metadata.Goal: Complete depa-orm-ready annotation profiles in kunun-type-annotations.
Metadata.Description: Fill remaining depa-orm adapter gaps for field properties, relation order identifiers, validation helpers, and entity/datasource profiles.

TaskGroup.name: Field and relation profile coverage
TaskGroup.Description: Add missing field properties and relation order identifier parsing.

Task.name: Support field properties key
Task.Description: Parse canonical `properties = [...]` and legacy `property` into field property descriptors.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests cover canonical `properties` and compatibility `property` forms.

Task.name: Extend relation order descriptors
Task.Description: Parse DataQueryIdentifier-like order fields including namespace, alias, order_set, entity_name, and relative_path.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Relation tests assert extended order fields are preserved.

TaskGroup.name: Validation helpers
TaskGroup.Description: Add depa-oriented validation helpers for relation annotation descriptors.

Task.name: Add relation validation helper
Task.Description: Validate relation type, cardinality, cascade values, endpoint shapes, join-key counts, and through path continuity.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Validation tests cover invalid enum values and through continuity gaps.

TaskGroup.name: Entity and datasource profiles
TaskGroup.Description: Add typed ORM entity and datasource annotation profiles and focused verification.

Task.name: Add entity and datasource profiles
Task.Description: Parse entity type, primary key, db, logical delete, datasource key, name, kind, env_conn, and options metadata.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests cover direct markers and annotated Knots for entity/datasource profiles.

Task.name: Run verification
Task.Description: Run type-annotations tests, focused type-system tests, typecheck, XML validation, and codument strict validation.
